en: If you disagree with a coverage or payment decision by Original Medicare, your Medicare Advantage plan, or your Medicare drug plan, you can file an appeal.
zh: 如果您不同意 Original Medicare、您的 Medicare Advantage 计划或您的 Medicare 处方药计划做出的承保或付款决定，您可以提出申诉。

en: You can file an appeal if Medicare or your plan refuses to cover a service you think should be covered, refuses to pay for something you already got, or stops providing or paying for care you think you still need.
zh: 如果 Medicare 或您的计划拒绝承保某项您认为应当承保的服务、拒绝为您已经接受的项目付款，或者停止提供、停止支付某项您认为仍然需要的照护，您都可以提出申诉。

en: The appeals process varies based on the kind of coverage you have. Generally, there are 5 levels of appeals. If you disagree with the decision made at any level of the process, you can usually go to the next level.
zh: 申诉流程因您所持保险类型而异。一般分为 5 级。如果您不同意其中任何一级作出的决定，通常可以进入下一级继续申诉。

en: At each level you'll get a decision letter with instructions on how to move to the next level of appeal.
zh: 每一级审理结束后，您都会收到一封决定通知函，里面会说明如何进入下一级申诉。

en: If you're in a Medicare Advantage plan, other health plan, or a drug plan, check your plan materials, or contact your plan, for details about your appeal rights. The plan must tell you, in writing, how to appeal.
zh: 如果您参加的是 Medicare Advantage 计划、其他健康计划或处方药计划，请查阅您的计划资料，或直接联系您的计划，了解申诉权利的具体规定。计划方必须以书面形式告知您如何提出申诉。

en: Before you start an appeal, you can ask your provider or supplier for any information to make your appeal stronger.
zh: 在提出申诉之前，您可以向您的医疗服务提供者或供应商索取任何有助于加强您申诉理由的资料。

en: To get a judicial review in federal district court, the amount of your case must meet a minimum dollar amount. You may be able to combine claims to meet this dollar amount.
zh: 若要向联邦地区法院申请司法复审，您案件的争议金额必须达到规定的最低门槛。您可以将多笔理赔合并计算，以达到该金额要求。

en: You have the right to a fast appeal if you think your Medicare-covered services are ending too soon. This includes services you get from a hospital, skilled nursing facility, home health agency, comprehensive outpatient rehabilitation facility, or hospice.
zh: 如果您认为 Medicare 承保的服务结束得过早，您有权申请快速申诉。这适用于您在医院、专业护理机构、居家健康护理机构、综合门诊康复机构或安宁疗护机构所接受的服务。

en: Your provider will give you a written notice before your services end that tells you how to ask for a fast appeal. If they don't give you this notice, ask for it.
zh: 在服务结束之前，您的医疗服务提供者会给您一份书面通知，说明如何申请快速申诉。如果对方没有给您这份通知，请主动索取。

en: If you have a trusted family member or friend helping you with a complaint, you can appoint them as a representative.
zh: 如果有您信任的家人或朋友协助您处理投诉，您可以指定对方作为您的代理人。

en: This notice tells you that Medicare usually covers this item or service, but may not cover it in your particular situation, for example because it is not considered medically necessary.
zh: 本通知是要告知您：Medicare 通常承保此项目或服务，但在您的具体情况下可能不予承保，例如因为不被认定为医疗上必需。

en: This notice gives you the information you need to decide whether to receive the item or service. If you choose to receive it and Medicare does not pay, you may be responsible for the full cost.
zh: 本通知向您提供必要信息，以便您决定是否接受该项目或服务。如果您选择接受，而 Medicare 最终不予支付，您可能需要承担全部费用。

en: You are being informed that you are an outpatient receiving observation services and are not an inpatient of the hospital. This may affect what you pay and whether Medicare will cover skilled nursing facility care afterward.
zh: 现通知您：您目前是接受观察服务的门诊病人，并非住院病人。这可能影响您需要自付的金额，以及之后 Medicare 是否承保专业护理机构的照护费用。

en: This notice states what action the agency intends to take and the effective date of that action.
zh: 本通知载明本机构拟采取的处理措施，以及该措施的生效日期。

en: This notice includes a clear statement of the specific reasons supporting the intended action, and the specific regulations or change in federal or state law that requires the action.
zh: 本通知明确说明支持该项处理措施的具体理由，以及要求采取该措施的具体法规，或联邦或州法律的相关变更。

en: You have the right to request a state agency hearing. If the action is based on a change in law, this notice explains the circumstances under which a hearing will be granted.
zh: 您有权申请州机构听证。如果该项处理措施是基于法律变更作出的，本通知会说明在何种情况下才会受理听证申请。

en: This notice explains the circumstances under which your Medicaid benefits are continued if you request a hearing.
zh: 本通知说明：如果您申请听证，在何种情况下您的 Medicaid 福利可以继续维持。

en: If you request a hearing before the effective date of this action, your benefits may continue unchanged until a decision is made. If the decision is not in your favor, you may be required to repay the cost of any benefits you received during that period.
zh: 如果您在本措施生效日期之前申请听证，您的福利可能在裁决作出之前维持不变。但如果裁决结果对您不利，您可能需要偿还这段期间已领取福利所产生的费用。

en: It is time to renew your health coverage. If we are able to renew your coverage using information we already have, you will receive a notice and will not need to take any action.
zh: 您的医疗保险已到续保时间。如果我们能够使用现有信息为您办理续保，您会收到一份通知，无需采取任何行动。

en: If we need more information, you must respond by the date shown on the notice. If you do not respond, your coverage may end.
zh: 如果我们需要补充信息，您必须在通知上所示日期之前答复。如果您未作答复，您的保险可能会被终止。

en: You must report any change in your household size, income, address, or immigration status within 10 days of the change.
zh: 您的家庭人数、收入、地址或移民身份如有变动，必须在变动发生后 10 天内申报。

en: If your coverage ends, you may still qualify for other affordable health coverage. You will receive information about your options and the deadline to enroll.
zh: 即使您的保险被终止，您仍可能符合其他可负担医疗保险的资格。您会收到有关可选方案以及投保截止日期的信息。

en: Please note that this is not a guarantee of payment. Benefits are subject to eligibility and the terms of the member's plan at the time services are rendered.
zh: 请注意，这并不构成付款保证。给付以服务实际提供当时会员的参保资格和计划条款为准。

en: This service requires prior authorization. Your provider must submit a request and receive approval before the service is provided, or the claim may be denied.
zh: 此项服务需要事先授权。您的医疗服务提供者必须在提供服务之前提交申请并获得批准，否则该笔理赔可能会被拒付。

en: We reviewed your request and determined that the requested service is not covered under your plan. This notice explains the reason for the decision and the clinical criteria we applied.
zh: 我们已审核您的申请，认定所申请的服务不在您的计划承保范围内。本通知会说明作出该决定的理由，以及我们所依据的临床标准。

en: You may request a copy of the clinical criteria used to make this decision, free of charge. You may also request a copy of all documents relevant to your claim.
zh: 您可以免费索取作出该决定所依据的临床标准副本，也可以索取与您的理赔相关的全部文件副本。

en: If you disagree with this determination, you have the right to file an appeal within 180 days of the date on this notice. You may also request an expedited review if a delay would seriously jeopardize your health.
zh: 如果您不同意本裁定，您有权自本通知所示日期起 180 天内提出申诉。如果延误会严重危及您的健康，您还可以申请加急审核。

en: Before we begin, I need to verify some information for security purposes. Can you please confirm the member's full name, date of birth, and member identification number?
zh: 在开始之前，出于安全考虑，我需要核实一些信息。请您确认一下会员的全名、出生日期和会员号，可以吗？

en: A Notice of Action is a written notice that explains your eligibility for coverage or benefits. It includes the eligibility decision and the effective date of coverage, as well as any changes made to your eligibility status or level of benefits.
zh: 处理决定通知书是一份书面通知，用于说明您在保险或福利方面的资格认定结果。其中包含资格认定决定、保险生效日期，以及您的资格状态或福利等级所发生的任何变更。

en: The notice must also include information about your hearing rights and how to appeal the decision if you disagree with the eligibility determination.
zh: 该通知还必须载明您的听证权利，以及在您不同意该项资格认定时应如何提出申诉。

en: If you do not understand your notice, or you have questions about your eligibility, please contact your local county office at the phone number listed on the notice.
zh: 如果您看不懂这份通知，或者对自己的资格认定有疑问，请拨打通知上所列的电话，与您所在县的办事处联系。

en: If you receive a notice in a language you are not able to read or understand, you should call the number on the notice and ask for assistance. You have the right to interpreter services provided by the county at no cost to you.
zh: 如果您收到的通知使用的是您无法阅读或理解的语言，请拨打通知上的号码请求协助。您有权获得由县方免费提供的口译服务。

en: If you disagree with any decision that has been made, you may file an appeal and request a state hearing.
zh: 如果您不同意已经作出的任何决定，您可以提出申诉并申请州级听证。

en: You may request a state hearing within 90 days of the date the notice was mailed to you. This deadline is set by federal law.
zh: 您可以在通知寄出之日起 90 天内申请州级听证。该期限由联邦法律规定。

en: If you request the hearing before the date the action takes effect, your benefits will continue unchanged while your appeal is pending. This is known as aid paid pending.
zh: 如果您在该措施生效日期之前提出听证申请，在申诉审理期间您的福利将维持不变。这种情况通常称为「待决期间继续给付」。

en: At the hearing you have the right to be represented by legal counsel, a friend, or another spokesperson of your choosing.
zh: 在听证会上，您有权由律师、朋友，或者您自行选定的其他代言人代表出席。

en: If you received more than one notice showing eligibility for different months, your coverage began in the earliest month listed, and there are no gaps in your coverage.
zh: 如果您收到多份通知，上面显示的生效月份各不相同，那么您的保险从所列最早的那个月起生效，中间没有断保。

en: If you have questions about whether you are eligible to have older medical bills paid, contact your county office.
zh: 如果您想了解自己是否符合资格、由计划支付较早期的医疗账单，请与您所在县的办事处联系。
